This week I finally started weightlifting. I increased my caloric intake so I have the energy to lift. Its also good that I moved my limit since this week, we went out 3 times for my mom's birthday, Pint Glass night at a bar, and an out-of-state friend was in town for 1 night. I was able to find something protein dense without too many calories at each restaurant. My average daily caloric intake during the week was 1560 cal. I met my goal of consuming between than 1200-1800 cal each day.

I did very well during the week before the dentist. My mid week weigh-in came in at 181.9 lbs., after 3 days of 1400+ cal deficits. According to my logging site, I've used 5457 more cal than I ate for the week. This should translate to 1.5 lbs. of real weight lose. I still have some fat I would like to lose before I start on eating at a surplus to put on muscle mass.

I went for a run twice times this week. I did a 5k for one of those runs and made a new personal record of 32:48 for 5k. That was my first milestone on 5k for me. My next 5k goal is to be able to finish one in 30 minutes. I also lifted weights twice this week. I completed 2 days of Stronglifts, most with a empty or near empty bar. I need to practice the barbell row the most.

Failures:

I drank more alcohol than I should have.

I have convinced my best man to start working out with me. He's been obese his whole life, even in elementary school. He recently had a son so he wants to be able to keep up with his kid a year from now when he starts moving around. Currently, he joins me on a running day and we'll talk while on treadmills. I found that it's much harder to running when I'm carrying on a conversation and not regulating my breathing. If I'm going to keep progressing on cardio, I'm going to have to push myself harder than I did last time I was with him. I think I can keep progressing while running with him, I just have to work harder at it. I will eventually see if I can convince him to join me in weightlifting and get him on Stronglifts as well.

The Half Mudder is now 13 weeks away. My goals for it are to be able to run 5 miles in an hour without feeling terrible, and to be able to perform 5 reps of pull-ups and dips. As my body fat goes down, these should become easier. I want to be able to run a 5k in 30 minutes by the end of March.
Week 6. Good. CW 179.5, down 1.2lbs this week, down 20.5lbs total.
Great job all around! You're doing very well here, I've got a feeling you're going to kill this half mudder!
